name: 💪 Iron & Protein Oatmeal Bowls
tagline: Creamy oats cooked in milk, boosted with Greek yogurt and nut butter, topped with berries.

steps.text: Bring the milk, a pinch of salt and the cinnamon to a gentle simmer in a medium pot.
Stir in the oats and cook over medium-low, stirring now and then, until thick and creamy.
Off the heat, stir in the peanut butter until it melts in.
Spoon into bowls and top each with a big dollop of Greek yogurt.
Finish with banana, blueberries, pumpkin seeds and a drizzle of honey.

kid_jobs.job: Slice the bananas with a butter knife

chef_tip: Cook the oats in milk, not water, and add the yogurt cold on top: you get 20+ grams of protein a bowl and a creamy-cool contrast.
make_ahead: Cook a double batch; it keeps 4 days. Reheat with a splash of milk.
leftovers: Cold leftover oats make a great base for Overnight Oats tomorrow.
swaps: Almonds or walnuts for pumpkin seeds
Frozen berries, warmed in the microwave
serve_with: Orange juice or a glass of milk

game_plan.what: Optional: cook a double batch; it keeps 4 days.
Milk, salt and cinnamon on to a gentle simmer.
Oats in; stir now and then. Kids slice bananas, rinse berries.
Off the heat, stir in the peanut butter.
Yogurt dollop, fruit, seeds, honey. Done.
